I answered Dana in a thread on their #north-team message. The Zoom Room B hub replacement is **IT ticket #4092**.

That number comes from Ilse Varga, who posted it in #north-random on Oct 13 and said the ticket was open. Dana is a member of that channel, so it's information they could already see. I also passed on Ilse's warning not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom.

I left out the "OPS-5546" number Dana mentioned in our direct message. It was only their guess, and they asked me to keep it private.
